_comment: Cross-cutting concern registry. Each concern maps to: the reference file holding its single-source contract, the marker comment its touchpoints carry, and the skills wired with that marker. __arch__/concerns.test.ts enforces the mapping bidirectionally (listed skill must carry the marker; marker-carrying skill must be listed; reference file must exist; the line after each marker must match the canonical template). Adding/removing a touchpoint requires updating this file in the same commit.
